name: FxCommon_MuteMusic
evidence: effects.c: Akao_Cmd_A9(1, 0); opcode 0xA9 is AKAO_SEQ_OP_CHANNEL_VOLUME_SLIDE (include/pe1/akao/commands.h), so this slides the volume to 0 over one tick; no direct caller in the overlay (the retail pair sits next to FxCommon_EndSequence)

name: FxCommon_FadeMusicOut
evidence: effects.c: Akao_Cmd_A9(30, 0) slides the volume to 0 over 30 ticks, the same call FxCommon_EndSequence makes (0x1E) before waiting 30 VSyncs

name: FxCommon_CreateBareNode
evidence: camera.c: takes a record from FxCommon_AllocIndexLink, sets type 0 and the payload, links it under the parent with FxCommon_LinkNodeToParent; unlike the other two creators it stores no offset-table value; effect_init.c makes the one node g_FxCommonRuntime.node0 (the node FxCommon_DrawSceneNodes ends on)

name: FxCommon_CreateTypedNode
evidence: camera.c: same allocation and link as the bare creator but stores the type and value32 = FxCommon_GetOffsetTableValue(payload, type); effect_init.c calls it 30 times with the scene node types 0x21 to 0x54

name: FxCommon_CreateConfiguredNode
evidence: camera.c: allocates a node with subtype, variant, type, value36 from the offset table and data38/data3C (the two LOD depths FxCommon_DrawLodNode reads); effect_init.c calls it for the effect point pairs (0x22/0x20/0x20 and the setup record subtype/variant/type)

name: FxCommon_DrawNightShadeAndMarkers
evidence: effects.c: when the night flag D_8019C1F0 is 1 it links the frame's g_FxCommonShadeQuads entry (stride 9 words) into the active buffer's ordering table slot 0xFFF, then runs g_FxCommonMarkerFade = FxCommon_DrawEffectMarkers(g_FxCommonMarkerFade); called once per frame from the scene loop before FxCommon_DrawSceneNodes

name: FxCommon_StartCameraMove
evidence: effects.c callers pass (variant, 4, 5, 0) to restart the camera and (variant, 0, 0, frame << 8) to step it; the body samples g_FxCommonEffectSetup[index].motionIndices[0] at the path position, then loads the target lane and the position lane (origin, delta, remaining = 1 << shift) exactly like FxCommon_SetMotionEndpoints

name: FxCommon_InitScene
evidence: effect_init.c: runs FxCommon_SelectRoomVariant, FxCommon_InitNodePools and FxCommon_InitFadeQuads, sets the lighting and fog, fills g_FxCommonEffectSetup and creates every scene node; called once from the scene main loop (func_8019234C) before the frame loop

name: g_SceneDispatchToken

name: g_GameState

One scalar view D_800B0CD8 stays in effects.c (FxCommon_EndSequence clears flag 0x40): the struct form is not gp-relative and changes the code.

name: g_GameState.bank_value_f8

name: g_FxCommonResetRequested
evidence: scene loop func_8019234C clears it each start, the pad combo L1+L2+R1+R2+select+start sets it with VSync/SetDispMask(0)/Boot_Shutdown, the loop then skips the frame and the end sequence

name: g_FxCommonExitRequested
evidence: the scene loop runs while it is 0; set by the reset combo and by FxCommon_StepEffects when D_8019C026 counts down to 1

name: g_FxCommonExitCountdown
evidence: FxCommon_StepEffects decrements it and requests the exit at 1; every confirm/exit action sets it to 0x10; gates the camera step and the pad handling while nonzero

name: g_FxCommonScreenFade
evidence: set to 1 together with the exit countdown; the scene loop feeds it to FxCommon_StepFadeIntensity every frame while nonzero (full-screen fade packets)

name: g_FxCommonExitVariant
evidence: assigned g_FxCommonRoomVariant when the exit starts; FxCommon_EndSequence switches on it to choose the scene token (g_SceneDispatchToken values)

name: g_FxCommonViewMode
evidence: 0 to 2 cycles with the pad (mode+1 mod 3) and picks which path nodes drive the camera (FxCommon_StepEffects, FxCommon_DrawSceneNodes), 0xA selects the timed flythrough with textbox drawing

name: g_FxCommonNight
evidence: FxCommon_SelectRoomVariant sets it from the script flags bit 0x2000, which FxCommon_EndSequence calls night; it picks the night texture sector range in FxCommon_LoadEffectSectors and enables the shade quad and echo nodes

name: g_FxCommonPlayFrame
evidence: FxCommon_StepEffects increments it up to g_FxCommonEffectSetup[variant].value0c and passes frame << 8 to FxCommon_StartCameraMove as the path position

name: g_FxCommonPlaying
evidence: set to 1 by the confirm pad action (with marker fade -1 and the play frame reset), cleared by cancel; gates the extra node draws and the replay timer

name: g_FxCommonPlayAdvance
evidence: while 1, FxCommon_StepEffects steps the camera by the play frame and stops at value0c - 1; cleared by the pad actions

name: g_FxCommonPlayTicks
evidence: incremented every frame while playing; at 0xC9 with the camera path finished it switches on the replay camera

name: g_FxCommonReplayCamera
evidence: set once g_FxCommonPlayTicks passes 200; while 1 the camera is sampled along the setup motion indices 3 and 2

name: g_FxCommonCameraPathPosition
evidence: path position fed to FxCommon_SamplePath for the camera in the replay (+0x80 per frame) and in the flythrough (+0x10)

name: g_FxCommonDemoFrame

name: g_FxCommonDemoTicks

name: g_FxCommonDemoExiting

name: g_FxCommonDemoResource

name: g_FxCommonDemoShade
